6.2.9.2.2 EEPROM driver
Detection
Reported by the EEPROM controller (see EEPROM controller above).
Reaction
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The job is aborted.
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The module state is set to MEMIF_IDLE, ready
to accept new jobs.
Report
 The error is reported to the DEM with the error code
EEP_E_COMPARE_FAILED.
Depending on the EEPROM Driver configuration:
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The error shall be polled by the EEPROM
Abstraction with the function Eep_GetJobResult (job result set to
MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [SWS_Eep_00068] The error shall be reported to the EEPROM
Abstraction by the callback function Fee_JobErrorNotification.
Recovery
N/A
